headline.en: Close the loop before beginning again

intro.zh: 十二月的主題是把忙碌收成可以交付的成果。公曆 12 月 1 至 8 日仍是農曆十月，12 月 9 日起進入農曆十一月。可以用前八天盤點未了事項，後半段挑一件值得帶進新年的事做深。這個節奏是編輯提案，不是擇日。
intro.en: December’s theme is turning a busy year into work you can hand over. December 1–8 falls in the tenth lunar month, and the eleventh begins on December 9. Use the first eight days to take stock, then deepen one commitment you want to carry into the new year. This is a planning suggestion, not a selection of auspicious dates.

method.zh: 本期以丙午年的傳統四化為靈感：天同化祿、天機化權、文昌化科、廉貞化忌。下文將它們轉成照顧關係、安排步驟、寫清楚和守界線的生活練習。這是公開的文化導讀。想了解四化落在哪一宮，請看自己的命盤。
method.en: This issue draws on the traditional transformations for the Bing-Wu year: Tian Tong Lu, Tian Ji Quan, Wen Chang Ke and Lian Zhen Ji. We use them as prompts for care, planning, clear writing and boundaries. This is a public cultural reading. Use your own chart to see which palaces the transformations occupy.

heading.zh: 把工作做成別人接得住的成果
heading.en: Make your work easy to hand over

body.zh: 借天機化權的調度意象，本月先分清「一定要交」和「可以明年再開」。如果手上三件事都在等別人回覆，先完成最接近交付的一件。
body.en: Using Tian Ji Quan as an image of coordination, separate what must ship from what can start next year. If three tasks are waiting on someone else, focus first on the one closest to a usable handover.

do.zh: 整理一頁交接，寫下成果、未決事項、接手人與下一個日期。
do.en: Write a one-page handover with the result, open questions, owner and next date.

avoid.zh: 避免拿還沒確定的人力與時間答應新的年底承諾。
avoid.en: Avoid promising new year-end work before confirming time and staffing.

heading.en: Say what you are hoping for

body.zh: 借天同化祿的照應意象，關係的重點可以放在一件雙方都做得到的小事。單身時，觀察對方的行動是否穩定；有伴時，說清楚年底想保留給彼此的時間。
body.en: Using Tian Tong Lu as a prompt for care, choose one small thing both people can do. If single, notice whether someone follows through. If partnered, say how much time you hope to reserve for each other at year-end.

do.zh: 把「你都不陪我」換成具體邀約，例如「週五能一起吃飯嗎？」
do.en: Turn “you never spend time with me” into a concrete invitation, such as dinner on Friday.

avoid.zh: 避免把忙碌時的一次晚回覆，直接解讀成對方的態度。
avoid.en: Avoid reading one late reply during a busy week as a verdict on the relationship.

body.zh: 把廉貞化忌用作界線提醒。聚餐、團購、合辦活動時，容易因為不好意思而把分工留到最後才講。事前說清楚，朋友之間反而輕鬆。
body.en: Treat Lian Zhen Ji as a reminder about boundaries. Dinners, group orders and shared events can get awkward when nobody wants to discuss responsibilities until the last minute. Agreeing early can make the gathering easier.

do.zh: 約定預算、分帳方式與誰負責訂位，再發出邀請。
do.en: Agree on the budget, split and booking owner before sending invitations.

avoid.zh: 不要為了維持熱絡，答應自己其實沒有時間或預算的邀約。
avoid.en: Avoid accepting an invitation you cannot afford in time or money simply to stay in the loop.

body.zh: 用文昌化科的清晰意象整理帳目。先看次月會扣的帳單、續訂與禮金，再決定十二月可以彈性使用多少。
body.en: Use Wen Chang Ke as a prompt for clarity. List next month’s bills, renewals and gifts before deciding how much December spending is flexible.

do.zh: 把固定支出、可調整支出和預留金分三欄，每週核對一次。
do.en: Track fixed costs, flexible spending and reserves in three columns and review them weekly.

avoid.zh: 避免把可能拿到的獎金算成已入帳，也別因折扣倒數就提前消費。
avoid.en: Avoid treating an expected bonus as money already received or buying early because a timer is running.

heading.en: Leave space to rest between plans

body.zh: 借天同照應的意象，把休息也排進行事曆。
body.en: Take the Tian Tong theme of care as a prompt to schedule recovery time.

do.zh: 密集聚會之間留一晚空白，維持平日的作息節奏。
do.en: Leave an evening free between busy gatherings and keep your usual routine where possible.

avoid.zh: 避免把原本需要的休息一直挪給臨時行程。
avoid.en: Avoid repeatedly giving up planned rest for last-minute events.

body.zh: 把天機的安排與文昌的清楚放在同一張清單：列出一件要結束、一件要延後、一件要帶進新年的事。
body.en: Bring Tian Ji’s planning and Wen Chang’s clarity to one list: one thing to finish, one to defer and one to carry into the new year.

do.zh: 替要結束的事約一個日期，把下一步告訴會受影響的人。
do.en: Set a date to finish and tell anyone affected what happens next.

avoid.zh: 避免年底一次重做所有計畫，先從能收尾的一件開始。
avoid.en: Avoid remaking every plan in December. Start with the one you can finish.
